title: Mozilla releases security update for thunderbird
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-382.12.03.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Mozilla Releases Security Update for Thunderbird
leadParagraph: Mozilla has released a security update to address a vulnerability in Thunderbird. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Mozilla has released a security update to address a vulnerability in Thunderbird. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to take control of an affected system.

It is encouraged that users and administrators to review the Mozilla Security Advisory for and apply the necessary update.

Please visit the link below:
Thunderbird 78.5.1
